summary: Sports-field car park with no homes nearby; park and bush on all sides.
reasons: Backs onto sports fields and creek bush
Flat, sealed, bays free along east edge

best_section.where: East edge of the sealed car park, beside the grass verge and footpath

drivers.seclusion: Surrounded by playing fields, parkland and creek bush; no dwellings in the data or imagery.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed car park with a clear entry road from the north; plenty of empty bays.
drivers.traffic: Arterial road lies beyond a roundabout to the north-east; van stands well clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Public car park with a handful of daytime cars; no signs mapped.

flags: Low-lying: about 10 m elevation, Cubberla Creek 48 m away
Sports field use and lighting may bring evening visitors
sun_shade: Open sealed surface; trees shade the north end, the south edge is under dense canopy.
cannot_judge: Whether the car park is locked at night
